test_title: PYST 13: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Four letter clusters are given. Out of which three are alike in some way and one is irrelevant. Select the irrelevant letter cluster.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73e690c12a66adaf209adf0b1ff008bb704c48783bd537b818e9d442fb16b230.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 
• **NRV → N + 4 = R; R + 4 = V**
 
• QVB → Q + 5 = V; V + 6 = B
 
• SXD → S + 5 = X; X + 6 = D
 
• YDJ → Y + 5 = D; D + 6 = J

Hence, '**NRV**' is the odd one out.
